ar.title: لحم البتلو المحشو بالية والثوم

steps.n1: يُفرد اللحم ويُدق ثم يُتبل بالملح والفلفل والبهار.
steps.n2: تُغرس أنصاف فصوص الثوم على أبعاد في اللحم.
steps.n3: تُوزع اللية على سطح اللحم، ثم تُلف القطعة وتُربط بخيط كتان.
steps.n4: يُشوّح اللحم في السمن، ثم يُضاف إليه كمية قليلة من الماء ويُغطى الإناء.
steps.n5: يُرفع الغطاء من وقت لآخر ويُقلب اللحم ويُضاف إليه قليل من الماء، وهكذا حتى يتم نضج اللحم.
steps.n6: يُرفع من الإناء ويُفك الخيط ويوضع في صحن وحوله الخلاصة التي طُهي فيها، ويُجمل بالبطاطس المسلوقة، أو يُقدم بارداً مجملاً بالبقدونس أو الخس وقليل من الطماطم.

en.title: Veal Stuffed with Tail Fat and Garlic

steps.n1: Spread out the meat, pound it, then season with salt, pepper and allspice.
steps.n2: Push half garlic cloves into the meat at intervals.
steps.n3: Scatter the tail fat over the surface of the meat, then roll it up and tie with linen string.
steps.n4: Sauté the meat in the ghee, then add a little water and cover the pot.
steps.n5: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the meat and add a little water, and continue until the meat is tender.
steps.n6: Lift it out of the pot, remove the string and place it on a plate with its cooking juices around it; garnish with the boiled potatoes, or serve cold garnished with parsley or lettuce and a few tomatoes.

legacySteps: Spread out the meat, pound it, then season with salt, pepper and allspice.
Push half garlic cloves into the meat at intervals.
Scatter the tail fat over the surface of the meat, then roll it up and tie with linen string.
Sauté the meat in the ghee, then add a little water and cover the pot.
Lift the lid from time to time, turn the meat and add a little water, and continue until the meat is tender.

Lift it out of the pot, remove the string and place it on a plate with its cooking juices around it; garnish with the boiled potatoes, or serve cold garnished with parsley or lettuce and a few tomatoes.
